name: paper-dev-review-layers-are-mandatory
description: Mandatory paper development review layers. Enforce independent review cadence across authoring and preparation cycles without resetting debt on quota stops or renamed drafts. Trigger phrases: review debt, three rounds without review, quota stopped reviewer, candidate-only round, pre-proof gate, mandatory skeptic, combined output limit, supplement equivalence, numeric reviewer confidence, statement ordinal, source content identity.

name: paper-dev-gitignored-state-discovery
description: Discover gitignored paper-dev state before committing. Before staging files for a paper-dev commit, run `grep -E 'experiments|paper-dev' .gitignore` to discover which paper-dev state files are gitignored by project convention. The standard pattern across Article-* repos is: `.paper-dev-state.json` and `.paper-dev-state.json.lock` and `experiments.tsv` are GITIGNORED (volatile per-session state), while `.paper-dev-retro.md`, `.paper-dev-learnings.md`, `.paper-dev-agents.json` ARE COMMITTED (durable artifacts). The negation pattern `!.paper-dev-retro.md` whitelists the retro/learnings/agents files. DO NOT try to `git add` gitignored files blindly — they'll silently skip with no error and you may not notice the omission. Trigger before any paper-dev commit, when discovering a paper-dev workflow on a new repo, when an experiments.tsv file isn't appearing in git status, or when designing a new Article-* repo's .gitignore.

name: paper-dev-artifact-layouts-for-tooling
description: Tooling over paper-dev state must handle three review layouts, legacy repos and headerless logs. The logs are experiments.tsv files and the legacy repos are pilot-runner ones. Article-* repos vary: canonical .paper-dev-state.json, legacy Progress.md pilot-status bullets, reviews under reviews/paper-dev timestamp dirs or loose reviews/*.md, TSV with or without the 17-column header. paper-dev-dash embodies all of it. Trigger phrases: paper-dev tooling, parse paper-dev state, read experiments.tsv, review memo format, pilot-runner legacy repo, Progress.md authority, NEEDS_FEEDBACK scan, dashboard over Article repos, paper-dev state schema.
